text.en:
BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE No. S 36

TELECOMMUNICATION SUCCESSOR COMPANY ORDER, 2001 (S 37/01} NOMINATION UNDER SECTION 3(1)(a) In exercise of the power conferred by paragraph (a} of subsection (1} of section 3, the Minister of Finance hereby nominates Telekom Brunei Berhad as the telecommunication successor company for the purposes of section 3 of the Telecommunication Successor Company Order, 2001. Dated this 4th. day of Safar, 1427 Hijriah corresponding to the 4th. day of March, 2006.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

MINISTER OF FINANCE, BRUNEI DARUSSALAM. Dicetak oleh PENGIRAN HAJI ZAINAL ABIDIN BIN PENGIRAN SERI WIJAYA PENGIRAN HAJI AHMAD, Pemangku Pengarah Percetakan, di Jabatan Percetakan Kerajaan, Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510, Negara Brunei Darussalam. Harga B$5.00
